$comment: Documentation-oriented fixture. Producer: simulator TrialEvent.marker_string / simopenbci.markers_contract. Consumer: pipeline.live.parse_marker_text (reads kind and label, ignores code). Tests: simulator/tests/test_marker_contract.py, pipeline/tests/test_marker_wire_contract.py.
rules: Exactly two separators delimit the first two fields; the label is everything after the second ':' and may itself contain ':'.
kind is the event class (trial_start, rest, ...), code is the dataset-native code, label is a short display label.
